headline: Executive order sets the line of officials who would temporarily lead the Interior Department if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order sets an order of succession for the Department of the Interior. That means it lists which officials would act as Secretary of the Interior if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. Only the title was available, so the specific positions and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of the Interior
who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily take over the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 14, 2020; no separate effective date is given in the available material.
